item.title: Earth's "vital signs" pushed to record extremes in 2026, report says
item.description: Climate change has pushed the planet's environmental systems "deeper into uncharted territory," researchers said in a new report centered on the state of Earth's climate in 2026.

item.title: Why AI could end the price tag as we know it
item.description: Retailers want to harness the power of artificial intelligence to set personalized prices for shoppers, a consumer protection expert says.

item.title: Doctor on Pope Leo's lung cancer diagnosis: "Don't have to be a smoker in order to get lung cancer"
item.description: The Vatican says that Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer, but is recovering as expected from a surgery to remove a nodular lesion on his lung. CBS News' Chris Livesay reports, plus Dr. Jonathan LaPook comments on the Pope's health.

item.title: Houthis launch new attack on Saudi capital as Trump mulls strikes
item.description: Iran's Houthi allies launch a new attack on Saudi Arabia and promise more to come as Trump considers U.S. action on the new front line in the wider Mideast war.

item.title: U.S. wants to "put pressure on Ukraine" to end war, former ambassador says
item.description: The U.S. may have intentionally withheld warnings to Ukraine of the Russian attack that killed six people and cut power to over 600,000, sources tell CBS News. Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William B. Taylor shares his thoughts.

item.title: New search for Amelia Earhart's missing plane
item.description: What happened to Amelia Earhart? Earhart and her navigator Fred Noonan vanished almost 90 years ago as she sought to become the first woman to fly a plane around the Earth. A team of academics and archaeologists is searching off a remote island in Kiribati, hoping to find her plane. CBS News' Lana Zak spoke with that team.

item.title: How technology is changing the detection of breast cancer
item.description: Dr. Rachel Brem tells Norah O'Donnell how AI is helping detect breast cancer earlier, and what younger women need to know about starting mammograms.

item.title: Netflix cutting workforce as its revenue growth slows
item.description: The layoffs will affect the company's product, tech, legal and HR teams, Netflix leaders said in a memo to employees.

item.title: Dozens of North Korean laptop farms discovered across Texas
item.description: Federal officials have discovered dozens of laptop farms across North Texas used by North Korea. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul has more.

item.title: Pope's cancer prognosis may depend on these factors, doctors say
item.description: Pope Leo XIV was diagnosed with lung cancer after a surgery that removed a nodular lesion from his right lung, the Vatican said.

item.title: New details on OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting recording device
item.description: An OpenAI engineer has been arrested after allegedly planting a secret recoring device in one of the company's conference rooms. Scott Stedman, investigative journalist at The Newsground, dug into the suspect's background.

item.title: New details in text messages between Jane Doe and frat members
item.description: One of the accused fraternity members, who was later expelled, wrote to her: "I genuinely hope ur not catching as much heat from this as we r."

item.title: ​World's oldest shipwreck found off Turkey's coast, archaeologists say
item.description: ​Archaeologists in Turkey have dated the shipwreck to between 4,400 and 4,700 years old.

item.title: Trump is less popular than ever among Latino voters, report shows
item.description: President Trump's approval rating is at a record low among Latino voters, a new report shows. CBS News' Cristian Benavides reports.

item.title: Understanding Iran's Houthi rebel allies
item.description: Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen are trading strikes with a Saudi-led coalition. CBS News' Dov Lieber has more context.

item.title: FBI arrests OpenAI employee for allegedly planting recording device at company headquarters
item.description: The FBI has arrested Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old OpenAI engineer who allegedly planted a recording device in the company's headquarters. CBS News' Lauren Fichten has more.

item.title: Judge blocks Trump's White House ban targeting CNN, MS NOW and Politico
item.description: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly said the White House's revocation of hard passes for CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists likely violated their First and Fifth Amendment rights.

item.title: What are Iran and Russia's mounting hybrid attacks on Europe?
item.description: Britain's domestic spy chief says "hybrid tactics" used by Russia and Iran are evolving. Here are some of the most notable incidents of 2026.F

item.title: DOJ tells California to review whether noncitizens got mail ballots
item.description: The Justice Department has ordered California to review a list of people who the federal government believes may have received mail-in ballots for the upcoming election despite not being U.S. citizens.

item.title: Fossil overlooked for 100 years ID'd as new dinosaur species
item.description: A fossil discovered 100 years ago in the U.K. has been identified as a previously unknown cousin of the T. rex, and it "definitely would have chased us."

item.title: German police seize robot that allegedly groped a teenage girl
item.description: German police have seized a humanoid robot after it allegedly touched a 16-year-old girl in an indecent manner and made sexually suggestive gestures.

item.title: U.S. blasts "embarrassing" complaint against Lebanon's ambassador
item.description: The Trump administration sharply criticized a legal complaint filed in Lebanon against the country's ambassador to Washington over her reported outreach to her Israeli counterpart.

item.title: Social Security announces cost-of-living increase for 2027
item.description: The 2027 cost-of-living adjustment is the largest since 2023. Here's how it will impact the typical benefit check starting early next year.

item.title: Inflation surged in September as U.S. energy costs jumped
item.description: Gas prices, which jumped 9.1% in September from August, accounted for more than half the monthly rise in inflation.

item.title: Top meme coin buyers vying for Trump dinner appear to be overseas
item.description: At least 52 $TRUMP holders moved funds through crypto exchanges that bar U.S. customers.

item.title: OpenAI employee accused of planting recording device in office
item.description: A Saudi national who worked at OpenAI as an engineer is suspected of planting a recording device in one of the company's conference rooms.

item.title: 10/11/2026: In the Line of Fire; Lost Sheep; Jon Batiste
item.description: First, an inside look at Secret Service operations. Then, reporting on West Bank settler violence. And, Jon Batiste: The 60 Minutes Interview.

item.title: Guilfoyle associate says when she asked him for $100K, it was "quid pro quo"
item.description: White House officials were told that text messages between Kimberly Guilfoyle and Eric Deters were real, sources told CBS News.

item.title: Details emerge in case of former Cornell student alleging rape by frat members
item.description: A woman, identified only as Jane Doe, alleges she was gang-raped by seven fraternity members in 2024 and accuses Cornell University of failing to protect her.

item.title: Jane Doe's account of what happened at Cornell fraternity house
item.description: A former Cornell student, identified as Jane Doe, filed a civil lawsuit against the school and seven former fraternity brothers she accuses of rape and sexual assault.
